Validated Diagram Generation: prepare a revision, then obtain canvas acknowledgement
|-- [M] Boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- DiagramEditService exposes start/get/wait/cancel; keeps preparation and installation internal
|   |-- DiagramBatchService coordinates child edit services through collecting canvas adapters
|   |-- Model execution sits behind DiagramGenerator
|   |   `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime uses PiAgentRuntime + validated submission; Fake runtime also implements the port
|   |-- Domain revision store accepts candidate edits and issues diagram revisions
|   |-- Canvas ports expose snapshot/apply/create; batch orchestration additionally requires batch
|   `-- runAgentWorkflow is a separate abstraction; this diagram runtime does not invoke it
|-- [C] Prepare: new request -> generating
|   |-- Validate operation options, template and supplied context identity before model execution
|   |-- [D] Generation request depends on captured inputs
|   |   |-- Canvas snapshot at expected document version + exact target/reference diagram revisions
|   |   |   |-- Anchored target must still have the requested baseRevisionId
|   |   |   `-- Import revision identities; resolve references to pinned text or node excerpts
|   |   |-- Instruction + template/options + base content + logical nodeRefs + canvas connections
|   |   |-- Replacement scope: whole diagram or selected ranges
|   |   |   `-- Variant refinement uses its retained head revision and saved scope
|   |   `-- Optional agent context
|   |       `-- For model edits without supplied context, load bound context only if source fingerprint matches
|   |-- Produce each revision
|   |   |-- Supplied candidate -> submitStoredDiagramEdit directly
|   |   `-- Model path -> generateDiagram -> DiagramGenerator.generate(cloned request)
|   |       |-- Check base revision belongs to the requested diagram
|   |       |-- Pi runtime resolves context sources and imports messages into a session
|   |       |-- session.prompt -> submit_diagram_edit(candidate)
|   |       |   |-- Invalid content or replacement scope -> report issues; allow correction and resubmission
|   |       |   `-- Valid -> retain candidate and request termination
|   |       `-- Require accepted submission -> revalidate -> return -> check abort -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
|   |-- Domain submission returns an issued diagram revision; canvas installation is still pending
|   `-- Assemble operation output before installation
|       |-- In-place edit -> one prepared revision
|       |-- Variant edit -> generate alternatives sequentially -> validate review records
|       |   `-- Optionally attach presentation alternatives referring to generated revisions
|       `-- Create -> requested number of new diagrams; extend -> one new diagram with source anchors
|-- [C] Install: prepared output -> applying -> canvas receipt
|   |-- Edit -> canvas.apply(revision, optional variants)
|   |   `-- Transfer target node + original baseRevisionId + expected document version
|   |-- Create/extend -> read latest canvas -> choose placement -> canvas.create(prepared content)
|   |   |-- Use explicit origin or placement beside anchor; revalidate extension anchors
|   |   `-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> refresh placement and retry, at most 3 attempts
|   `-- Batch -> prepare every child against one shared snapshot before calling real canvas.batch
|       |-- Reject multiple edit operations targeting the same logical diagram
|       |-- Run children sequentially; adapters collect revisions/creations instead of installing them
|       |-- Child completion means prepared; child failure prevents the real batch call
|       `-- All children succeed -> submit collected application with shared expected document version
|-- [C] Request identity and acknowledgement recovery: shared policy for edit and batch runs
|   |-- Lookup key = (sessionId, caller requestId); signature describes the request
|   |   |-- Different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   `-- Same signature -> return retained run state, except the recovery case below
|   |-- Installation uses the stable runId as the canvas mutation requestId
|   |-- Canvas receipt -> completed; report acknowledged document version and operation results
|   |-- Applying + CANVAS_TIMEOUT / CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE / PERSISTENCE_PENDING
|   |   `-- awaiting-acknowledgement; matching start with no pending work retries installation only
|   |       `-- Reuse prepared revisions or batch application; creation may refresh placement
|   |-- VERSION_CONFLICT after applicable placement retries -> conflict; other errors -> failed
|   `-- Cancellation acts only while generating; dispatched application is not labelled cancelled
`-- [O] Retention and execution lifetimes
    |-- Edit run owns cloned input, signature, status, abort controller, contexts and prepared output
    |-- Batch run owns collected application/results and tracks the active child during preparation
    |   `-- Cancellation propagates to that child; successful preparation clears child tracking
    |-- Services retain request/run maps in memory, including completed runs
    |   `-- No eviction is shown; capacity is bounded, and dispose cancels generation without clearing maps
    `-- Pi runtime tracks active sessions; session history is persisted for audit
        |-- Submission closure retains the accepted candidate for its generation call
        |-- Abort signal requests session abort
        `-- Prompt execution's finally removes listeners, disposes the session and removes it from tracking
